title: Lecture Wednesday Evening in Denver
content: I'll be lecturing tomorrow evening at the Denver Botanical Garden's "Café Botanique."The event is Wednesday, September 14, 2016 - 6:30 PM, and the fee for adults is $5.00The topic is "Color and Light in the Landscape," richly illustrated with visual examples in a digital slide show.There will be a Q and A session and book signing afterward.James Gurney at Café Botanique, Wednesday, September 14.
